spec_references: ## Expressions: the supported expression list does not include typeof expressions.

reason: Although cloneWithType and the map/array operations are explicitly supported, the case essentially asserts runtime type descriptions through typeof expressions and inspects conversion errors with error.detail(), which is outside the supported lang.error methods.
